snippet.title: Monsterland. Junior vs Senior - Trailer 2
snippet.description:
Help Junior to wake up Senior in this free physics-based logical game for kids and adults. Click away as few mean monster blocks as possible to reunite a playful son and his tired dad for high scores and star ratings.

Android - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.almagames.monsterland1
iOS - https://geo.itunes.apple.com/app/id1107938990
